final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_rating_average FROM rating_averages), above_mean AS (SELECT r.avg_length FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN overall_average o WHERE r.avg_length > o.mean_rating_average), mean_above_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_above FROM above_mean), final_kept AS (SELECT r.avg_length, r.avg_length - o.mean_above AS difference FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN overall_average o CROSS JOIN mean_above m WHERE r.avg_length > o.mean_average AND r.avg_length > m.mean_above) SELECT AVG(avg_length), AVG(difference), AVG(difference - (SELECT mean_above FROM mean_above)) FROM final_kept
